newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA.

text.p: Zimbabwe won the toss and chose to bat against South Africa in their day/night triangular series match at the Wanderers on Friday.
South Africa - Gary Kirsten, Andrew Hudson, Lance Klusener, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Craig Matthews, Allan Donald.
Zimbabwe - Grant Flower, Andy Waller, Alistair Campbell, Dave Houghton, Andy Flower, Craig Wishart, Guy Whittall, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Eddo Brandes, Everton Matambanadzo.
